value.rationale: A full conditional commuting centralizer-size distribution is a natural nontrivial group-theoretic invariant; it sharpens known involution totals, distinguishes the involution-induced graph from ambient commuting graphs, and yields an exact commuting probability with a meaningful 1/4 large-field law at the first 4-by-4 unitriangular case. The rank-one incidence calculation is a structural mechanism, not simply a brute-force finite table.
